headline: ماذا حدث حين جعلت المستشفيات الإجراء الصحيح خيارًا جاهزًا؟
reviewer: AI editorial review (not a human reader test)

introduction_answers.problem: لا يحصل كثير من كبار السن المصابين بأمراض مزمنة متقدمة على استشارة الرعاية التلطيفية، إذ لا تُطلب إلا إذا قرّر الطبيب ذلك.
introduction_answers.who: مرضى أحد عشر مستشفى أمريكيًا وأطباؤهم.
introduction_answers.change: صار طلب الاستشارة خيارًا جاهزًا يُسجَّل تلقائيًا ما لم يُلغِه الطبيب، فارتفعت النسبة من 16.6% إلى 43.9%.

summary: جعلت تجارب في مستشفيات أمريكية الإجراء الموصى به خيارًا جاهزًا في أنظمتها، فاستُخدم أكثر، لكن النتائج لم تتحسّن دائمًا، وكتب الجراحون معظم الوصفات بأنفسهم حين كان ذلك ممكنًا.
fixes_before_publication: Title changed from «ماذا يحدث حين يصبح الإجراء الصحيح هو الخيار الجاهز؟» to name the actor (hospitals) and the action.
Introduction now opens with the concrete problem and who faces it, and explains palliative care and the default at first use.
«تنتظر أن يتذكّرها الطبيب» changed to «لا تُطلب إلا إذا قرّر الطبيب ذلك» to match the source wording (clinicians could choose to order).
Do-not-resuscitate order and risk of bias explained at first use; English glossary terms placed in parentheses after the Arabic term.
terminology_evidence: Palliative care, default option, opt-out/opt-in, nudge, order set, do-not-resuscitate order, risk of bias, Bayesian analysis and tidal volume are explained at first use or in the glossary.
language_evidence: Arabic written natively from meaning; title and introduction re-read without the title (editorial simulation, not a human reader test).

mobile_evidence.scope: Automated rendered-layout verification; screenshots retained for human visual review

source_evidence.claim: 11 hospitals; 34,239 enrolled; 24,065 analysed; consult 43.9% vs 16.6%; 3.4 vs 4.6 days; length of stay unchanged
source_evidence.assessment: Denominators: default-order group (n=10,313) vs usual care (n=13,752); randomized stepped-wedge trial

source_evidence.claim: Medication 60% vs 34%; counseling call 89% vs 37%; quit 22% vs 16% at 1 month, 19% vs 18% at 6 months
source_evidence.assessment: Percentages of opt-out vs opt-in groups; Bayesian analysis; single hospital

source_evidence.claim: Only 21% of intervention-group encounters used pre-populated prescriptions; no overall MME difference
source_evidence.assessment: Denominator: 377 intervention encounters; single academic center

source_evidence.claim: 12 ICUs, 4,412 patients; no significant difference in low tidal volume fidelity; variation by ICU
source_evidence.assessment: No significant differences after Holm adjustment

source_evidence.claim: 19 of 24 nudges (79.2%) improved care; only one study at low risk of bias
source_evidence.assessment: Systematic review of hospital EHR nudges
Systematic review of primary care EHR nudges; most studies moderate risk of bias
